req.title: PUT rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a playerId that does not exist.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a PUT request to update a player with a non-existent playerId should return a 404 error. This behavior ensures that the system correctly handles attempts to update resources that do not exist, maintaining data integrity and providing clear feedback to the client.

tests.name: test_put_unknown_player_positive
preconditions: The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/27 with valid player data.
expected: The response status code should be 404.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/27", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 404
